clips.name: slit-scan
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage, original left and with Slit Scan right: every strip of the picture further right shows a moment further back, so her arms and skirt stretch into pleated, rippling smears and a hand trails behind her
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Slit Scan at its default settings (the Sweep preset): the right edge of the frame is 3 s behind the left.

clips.name: slit-scan-delay
clips.alt: The dancer with Slit Scan while Delay runs from 0 to 3 s and back: at 0 she is the plain picture, then her arms and skirt stretch into longer and longer pleated smears and gather again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Delay from 0 to 3 s and back.

clips.name: slit-scan-angle
clips.alt: The dancer with Slit Scan at Delay 2 s while Angle turns from 0° to 180° and back: the smears run sideways, then up and down, then sideways the other way; the current angle is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Angle from 0° to 180° and back, at Delay 2 s.

clips.name: slit-scan-mix
clips.alt: The dancer with Slit Scan at Delay 2 s while Mix runs from 0 to 1 and back: the smeared picture fades in over the plain one as a ghost and becomes solid; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Mix from 0 to 1 and back, at Delay 2 s.

clips.name: slit-scan-bands
clips.alt: The dancer with Slit Scan at Delay 2 s and Time bands 0, 3, 8 and 24, about a second each: the smooth smear becomes three, eight and twenty-four upright strips, each from one moment; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Time bands 0, 3, 8 and 24, at Delay 2 s.

clips.name: slit-scan-waves
clips.alt: The dancer with the Wave / folds profile at Delay 2 s while Waves runs from 0.5 to 6 and back: one broad fold becomes many narrow upright folds that cut her into repeated slices; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Waves from 0.5 to 6 and back, Wave / folds at Delay 2 s.

clips.name: slit-scan-phase
clips.alt: The dancer with the Wave / folds profile at Delay 2 s and Speed 0 while Phase runs from 0 to 1 and back: the folds slide sideways across her body by one whole wave and back; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Phase from 0 to 1 and back, Wave / folds at Delay 2 s, Speed 0.

clips.name: slit-scan-speed
clips.alt: The dancer with the Time rings profile at Delay 2 s and Speed 0, 0.25 and 1 cycles/s, about one and a half seconds each: the rings stand still, then drift slowly inwards, then race inwards; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Speed 0, 0.25 and 1 cycles/s, Time rings at Delay 2 s.

clips.name: slit-scan-time-map
clips.alt: Preview set to Time map with the Time Rings preset: black and white rings across the whole frame that slowly close in on the centre
clips.caption: Preview → Time map with the Time Rings preset: black is now, white the full Delay.

clips.name: time-stack
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage, original left and with Time Stack right: fainter and fainter copies of her arms, hair and dress fan out behind her as she turns, like a long-exposure photograph
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Time Stack at its default settings, the Echo Trail preset.

clips.name: time-stack-presets
clips.alt: The dancer five times in a grid, moving in sync, each with one preset: Echo Trail with fading copies fanning out behind her, Long Exposure with a long smear of the last two and a half seconds, Stroboscope with eight equally bright copies close together, Chorus with five whole dancers half a second apart, Afterglow with a short soft glow around her on a dark stage
clips.caption: The five presets on the moving dancer, in sync.

clips.name: time-stack-decay
clips.alt: The dancer with Time Stack while Decay runs from 0 to 1 and back: at 0 she is alone, then fading copies appear behind her and grow into a dense, equally bright crowd of arms and skirts at 1, and fade again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Decay from 0 to 1 and back.

clips.name: kinetic-trace
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage, original left and with Motion Trails right: her arms, hair and skirt leave pale streaks that fade within about a second as she turns
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Motion Trails at its default settings, the Light Trails preset.

clips.name: kinetic-trace-presets
clips.alt: The dancer five times in a grid, moving in sync, each with one preset: Light Trails with short pale streaks, Light Painting with streaks that hardly fade and fill the stage, Neon Trace with cyan trails, Embers with smoky orange trails, Afterimage with a soft lavender haze of earlier poses
clips.caption: The five presets on the moving dancer, in sync.

clips.name: kinetic-trace-length
clips.alt: The dancer with Motion Trails while Length runs from 0.5 to 0.98 and back: at 0.5 only a short smear follows her hands, at 0.98 long pale streaks of arms and skirt hang in the air before they fade; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Length from 0.5 to 0.98 and back.

clips.name: kinetic-trace-tint
clips.alt: The dancer with Motion Trails while Tint runs from 0 to 1 and back: the pale streaks behind her turn light blue, first at their old ends, then completely, and back to pale; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Tint from 0 to 1 and back, with the default light blue Overlay.

clips.name: kinetic-trace-softness
clips.alt: The dancer turning with Motion Trails at Length 0.95 while Softness rises from 0 to 6 px and back: at 0 her arms leave a comb of sharp separate copies, at higher values the older copies melt into soft continuous streaks
clips.caption: Softness from 0 to 6 px and back, at Length 0.95.

clips.name: kinetic-trace-amount
clips.alt: The dancer with Motion Trails while Amount runs from 0 to 1 and back: at 0 she is alone, then the full-length streaks appear faintly and grow stronger up to 1, and fade again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Amount from 0 to 1 and back.
